lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct white vertical lines are visible; the spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-torso and becomes progressively denser toward the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The four most posterior vertical markings are discontinuous, appearing as series of vertically aligned spots and dashed segments rather than solid lines.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A high density of approximately 10-12 white spots is clustered on the lateral posterior haunch and upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two semi-linear horizontal rows of spots are visible on the lower flank, positioned below the termination of the primary vertical stripes.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct white spot present on the mid-cheek and a prominent white horizontal band across the lower neck/throat area.
